title: P0.32: Governed User Chrome Bridge / External Session Selection
description: Closes the root-cause blocker: IABV uses an isolated browser profile (chatgpt_program_session) while the user is logged into their normal Chrome. This blocks external consultation because IABV cannot access the user's authenticated session. P0.32 adds a governed bridge with explicit permission, CDP detection, and manual fallback.
resume_hint: Implementation complete and loaded in the Windows runtime. P0.33 follow-up removed the PowerShell/command handoff: if CDP is unavailable, the UI now tells the user to type 'abrir chrome con puente' and can launch Chrome with CDP from inside IABV when Chrome is not already running.
next_action: User types 'usar mi chrome'. If CDP is unavailable, type 'abrir chrome con puente'. If Chrome is already running, close Chrome normally first or use manual pasteback. Then retry the ChatGPT consultation.
